notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
description:
Cast Tamiyo by paying {3}{U}{U}. Tamiyo enters the battlefield with eight loyalty counters on it due to Doubling Season.
Activate Tamiyo's third loyalty ability by removing eight loyalty counters from it, causing you to get its emblem.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Tamiyo's emblem triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 3.
